notes:
A number this site quotes is not a second line for this site.

USA.gov was told that "3 different phone numbers appear across the site" and
that they "read as variants of one line". The site publishes one number, in the
footer of all 24 crawled pages. The other two appeared once each, in a single
sentence, on a single page: "Or call 1-800-MEDICARE, (1-800-633-4227 TTY
1-877-486-2048)." That is Medicare's line and Medicare's TTY line, quoted in an
instruction about replacing a Medicare card.

The advice — "put secondary numbers only on the pages they belong to" — was
already exactly what those numbers were doing, and following it would have
removed the number a reader needs from the page about that subject.

NAP consistency is a claim about the numbers a site publishes as its own. The
extractor now records which numbers sit in the site chrome, and the check
compares those, plus schema, tel: links, and anything on a contact page. A site
that names none of its numbers that way is filtered by nothing, so the check
can never go blind.
